20686-T1
A SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT FOR
1812-14 WEST GRAND AVENUE, CHICAGO

The subject property is currently vacant. The City Council had previously rezoned this
property to its current B1-2 District, as a Type 1 Application. Since that rezoning was
done more than 2 years ago, the Applicant needed to refile the zoning change application.
The Applicant intends to build a new 4-story mixed-use building with commercial space
on the ground floor and 4 dwelling units on the upper floors.
